query:
SELECT 
  m.sponsorId,
  m.attendeeId,
  m.timeSlot,
  m.attendeeNumber,
  m.matchScore,
  s.companyName as sponsorName,
  s.meetingsPublished
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE s.meetingsPublished = 1 AND m.isVisible = 1
ORDER BY m.timeSlot, m.sponsorId, m.attendeeNumber;
